title: Roles
description: The shared count list and the roles people pick at setup: each role's funding sources, budget lines, tasks and the counts each task shows (decisions 0027, 0029). Format version 1.

version.description: Release number of this file's content. Bump it when roles or counts change.

counts.description: Every count any task shows, in display and entry log column order. Add new counts at the end; never delete one, mark it retired (decision 0029).

id.description: Entry log column name. Never changes and is never reused.

unit.description: Unit shown after the number, e.g. gal or sq ft. Values are whole numbers.

retired.description: Taken out of every task. Keeps its entry log column.

roles.description: Roles in the order setup lists them. Roles never name a person (decision 0027).

id.description: Stable id stored on the profile and entries. Never changes once released.

code.description: Short code shown with the name, e.g. CHW-TC01.

chw.description: Turns on the core competency column and the Work Hours Report (decision 0032).

suggested_rate_cents.description: Rate prefilled at setup when the funding entry has none (decision 0030).

certification_step.description: Invoiced or submitted hours after which the person is eligible for certification. Only on chw roles (decision 0032).

name.description: Short name on Home, e.g. CHW Cert.

certification_text.description: Overrides the source's certification_text for this role (decision 0031).

employee_certification_text.description: Overrides the source's employee_certification_text for this role (decision 0031).

retired.description: No longer offered. People in it move to replaced_by, if set (decision 0027).

replaced_by.description: Id of the active role that people in this retired role move to.

funding.description: The sources this role bills, in display order.

rate_cents.description: Rate prefilled at setup for this source (decision 0030).

nte_cents.description: Not-to-exceed prefilled at setup. Only for sources with an NTE; employee roles leave it out (decision 0031).

rate_step.description: A raise after a number of invoiced or submitted hours on this source. The app reminds; it never changes the rate (decision 0030).

ends.description: Last day this role can date hours on this source, inside the source's period (decision 0033).

budget_lines.description: The source's budget lines this role bills, in display order.

tasks.description: The source's tasks offered under this line, in display order.

count_ids.description: Counts this task shows, by id from the shared list. May be empty.
